$comment: What: JSON Schema (documentation) of preflight.json, written before every run (plan §5.5). How: read it to know the fields; the code check is validatePreflight() in tools/core/result-schema.mjs. Needs: nothing. Outputs: nothing; produced by tools/preflight/preflight.mjs runPreflight().
title: CCE performance preflight result

subject.description: Tested subject (comma-separated when several); null for a stack check

id.description: Check id of plan §7.1, e.g. service-health.matcher

severity.description: required: a fail stops the run

status.description: a fail of a warning-level check is reported as warn

data.description: Check-specific facts; plan-definition-set carries planDefinitions, otherActivePlanDefinitions and effectiveFanOut

warnings.description: '<id>: <detail>' of every warn, copied to result.conditions.preflight.warnings
